### Unified Strategy Synthesis (One Coherent Direction)
All 20 tools converge on **one unified execution architecture**: transform DDC Agriculture from an opportunistic single-SKU blade vendor (10.33M, 86% Base Cutter, 43 accounts) into **Thailand's #1 Value-Engineered Sugarcane Wear-Parts Partner (60.00M in CY2027 → 100M in 2027/28 Crop Season)** by combining **Hybrid Domestic+Import Manufacturing (7.5M CapEx)**, **3-Wave Seasonal Portfolio Rebalancing (40% BC / 20% Chopper / 40% High-GM Spares & Overhaul)**, **100% Wholesale Dealer Distribution (35–40 Shops) pulled by 4 Technical Sales Engineers**, and **Disciplined Financial Governance (3-Tranche WC, 3-Party Mill Credit, H1 Stage-Gate)**.
